column1: # The key of every hand-edited table under headers/ and spec/abi/ (HEADERS-FRAGMENTS), one line per table.
# `cargo xtask static` (table-keys, xtask/src/table_keys.rs) checks every table against its line and fails when two
# rows have the same key, when a table there has no line here, or a line names no table. Merge tooling reads this
# file to merge a table row by row: two stories adding different rows never conflict in meaning.
# The tables: lines starting with `#` and blank lines are comments; the first other line is the header, naming
# the columns; every later line is a row (a cell past the row's end is empty).
# Columns of this file (tab-separated, header line below):
#   path  the table, relative to the repository root.
#   key   the header names of the key columns, comma-separated, in order.
#   sort  `key`: rows are in strictly ascending byte order of the key (a new row goes in its place, not at the
#         end); `-`: no order (a new row goes where its story puts it; merge tooling appends).
#   unit  `row`: each row is one record, and no two rows have the same key. `block`: the rows with one key are one
#         record, contiguous (a flattened tree, e.g. a struct's members and their anonymous members, where rows
#         repeat); a key may not start a second block. A block is merged, kept in order, as a whole.
